official.application_cycle: Applications open September 2026 and close 15 March 2027, for the 2027 intake
official.status_note: Both MHA pages state "Applications are open now till 15 March 2027!" and were last updated on 1 September 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: MHA lists "Tuition fees and other approved charges" and states on its scholarships overview that scholars receive "full sponsorship of your undergraduate studies locally or overseas".
benefits: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Monthly overseas or local maintenance allowance (including accommodation)
Pre-studies allowance e.g. settling in, warm clothing, computer
Return economy class airfare (for selected scholarship tiers)
Sponsorship of Master's and exchange programmes (if requirements are met)
Vacation Attachment Programme, and placement on the Home Team Leaders-in Development Programme where criteria are met
eligibility: Singapore Citizen, or Singapore Permanent Resident who is intending to take up Singapore Citizenship
Strong interest in safeguarding the safety and security of Singapore
Good academic and Co-Curricular Activities (CCAs) records
A GCE A-Levels, International Baccalaureate, Polytechnic, NUS High School, or other high school diploma/certificate
Mid-term applicants: pursuing full-time undergraduate studies, on track for graduation with at least 2nd Upper Honours or equivalent, having completed at least 1 semester and not in the final year
requirements: Indicate your preferred Home Team Department and career track at the point of interview
Study at a local or overseas university in most disciplines except medicine, dentistry and architecture
Law degree holders will not be called to the Bar while serving in the Home Team
Changing specialisation or converting from the Civilian to the Uniformed scheme after award requires strong justification and MHA considers it case by case
coverage: Tuition fees and other approved charges
Monthly overseas or local maintenance allowance (including accommodation)
Pre-studies allowance e.g. settling in, warm clothing, computer

Sponsorship of Master's and exchange programmes (if requirements are met)

application_method: Apply through the "Apply Now" link on the MHA Civilian Scholarship page, which goes to the Public Service Commission scholarship portal

Complete the MHA selection stages: application, psychometric test, board interview with senior officers from various Home Team agencies, then a provisional offer subject to clearances and university placement
official.application_route: Apply through the "Apply Now" link on the MHA Civilian Scholarship page, which routes to the Public Service Commission scholarship portal.
official.citizenship_residency: Singapore Citizen, or Singapore Permanent Resident who is intending to take up Singapore Citizenship
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Most disciplines except medicine, dentistry and architecture; applicants intending to pursue Law will not be called to the Bar while serving in the Home Team. Specialist tracks (Commercial Affairs, Intelligence, Internal Security, Psychology) require the relevant discipline.
official.duration: Full-time undergraduate degree; bond of 4 years for local studies, 5 years for studies in non-English speaking countries and 6 years for studies in English speaking countries, starting on the day recipients assume official duty after completing their studies
official.description: The Ministry of Home Affairs Civilian Scholarship is awarded to all-rounded individuals who are passionate about strengthening Singapore's safety and security in a civilian appointment, with Generalist and Specialist tracks in Commercial Affairs, Intelligence, Internal Security and Psychology. It allows recipients to pursue undergraduate studies at a prestigious local or overseas university and kickstart a leadership journey in the Home Team.
official.program_type: Civilian public service undergraduate scholarship with Generalist and Specialist tracks

verification.notes: Read directly on MHA's own scholarship pages (both last updated 1 September 2026). MHA publishes the categories of award value but no monetary figures, and points applicants to the Public Service Commission portal and to the MHA scholarships information booklet for application documents, neither of which publishes a page figure.

applicant_utility.summary: MHA publishes what the scholarship covers but never how much, so assume the monthly maintenance allowance and pre-studies allowance are set by tier and negotiate nothing - decide whether the bond is worth it instead. The bond is the real cost: four years for local study, five for a non-English-speaking country and six for an English-speaking one, running from the day you take up duty, which means an overseas degree buys you a longer commitment. The process is unusually long and staged - application between September and March, then psychometric testing and a board interview through to June, with a provisional offer in June to July that is only confirmed after medical clearance, security clearance, NS performance and university placement.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents intending to take up citizenship who want a non-uniformed Home Team career in policy, research, communications, HR, finance, commercial affairs enforcement, intelligence, internal security or psychology.
application_readiness_checklist: Decide your preferred Home Team Department and career track before the board interview - you are asked to indicate it at interview, and changing it later needs strong justification
Weigh the bond length against your study destination: 4 years local, 5 years for a non-English-speaking country, 6 years for an English-speaking country
Check your intended degree is not medicine, dentistry or architecture, which are excluded
If you are a male applicant still serving National Service, confirm you can meet the NS performance condition before the provisional offer converts
Prepare for the psychometric test by resting, not revising - MHA says no preparation is needed
Research the Home Team agencies properly before the board interview; MHA's own guidance is to read widely so you can discuss current issues
common_rejection_risks: Applying as a Permanent Resident without a genuine intention to take up Singapore Citizenship, since that is an explicit condition
Underestimating the six-year bond attached to studying in an English-speaking country, then trying to exit early
Choosing an excluded degree (medicine, dentistry, architecture) or a Law degree without understanding the Bar restriction
Failing the security clearance stage, which sits after the board interview and can derail an otherwise successful application
Leaving the track decision until after the award - MHA earmarks you for a specific track or scheme at the point of award
Weak co-curricular records, which MHA lists alongside academic results as an eligibility requirement
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Not published. MHA lists tuition fees and other approved charges, a monthly maintenance allowance including accommodation, a pre-studies allowance and return economy airfare for selected tiers, but publishes no figures, so any cost beyond those categories - and the return airfare if you are not on a selected tier - must be funded yourself.
document_audit: MHA does not publish a document list on its scholarship pages - it directs applicants to the Public Service Commission scholarship portal and to the MHA scholarships information booklet at go.gov.sg/mhainfobooklet
The go.gov.sg short link opens a government redirect interstitial, so allow an extra click and confirm you land on an mha.gov.sg or psc.gov.sg page
Mid-term applicants must document that they are on track for at least 2nd Upper Honours and have completed at least one semester but are not in their final year
alerts: Applications close on 15 March 2027, but internal selection runs March to June and offers only go out June to July - plan your university acceptance timeline around that
The bond starts on the day you assume official duty after graduation, not when you start studying
Return economy class airfare is only for selected scholarship tiers, so do not assume it is included
Mid-term scholars get pre-award tuition and compulsory fees backpaid, which is a distinct benefit worth knowing if you are already mid-degree
There is no difference in promotion prospects between overseas and local scholars - MHA states promotions are based on potential and performance in service
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply through the PSC scholarship portal from September to 15 March 2027, then pass the psychometric test and board interview, and the provisional offer is confirmed after medical clearance, security clearance, NS performance and university placement.
